name: @vectojs/markdown
description: Canvas-native Markdown (and TeX math) rendering for VectoJS: a Markdown entity plus CodeBlock, built on @vectojs/ui components with marked + @vectojs/tex.

scripts.build: (cd ../ui && bun run build) && (cd ../tex && bun run build) && node scripts/build-worker.js && tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:e2e: bun e2e/blockquote-layout.e2e.ts && bun e2e/stream-controller.e2e.ts && bun e2e/lazy-math.e2e.ts && bun e2e/paragraph-image-repaint.e2e.ts && bun e2e/inline-image.e2e.ts && bun e2e/selection-fidelity.e2e.ts && bun e2e/code-atlas-dpr.e2e.ts && bun e2e/set-max-width.e2e.ts && bun e2e/block-affordances.e2e.ts
